module: D09-11 題材股與正式產業分類橋接

exposureEdges.basis: Issuer current official company profile explicitly lists production/sales of ABF substrate.
Issuer official product/technology materials include ABF and PP substrates.
Issuer current official product page identifies FCBGA as a high-end GPU/CPU substrate solution.
Issuer chairman message explicitly describes large-area high-layer-count ABF substrates and 2026 capacity deployment/customer certification.
exposureEdges.customerOrders: PARTIAL / customer identity not established here

coreCounterexample.fact: Two issuers with verified ABF/IC-substrate exposure sit in different formal TWSE industries: 8046 Electronic Parts/Components and 3189 Semiconductor.
coreCounterexample.implication: Theme/supply-chain groups require effective-dated many-to-many exposure edges; formal industry labels alone cannot define the theme universe.

pitRules: Current official formal-industry and issuer-product pages support prospective mapping from capturedAt; they are not automatically valid for earlier historical dates.
Historical formal-industry attribution requires classificationSchemeId plus effectiveFrom/effectiveTo/knownAt; current classification must not be backfilled.
Historical product/theme exposure requires evidence available at that historical decision clock; current product capability must not be backfilled.
Capability/product presence does not prove revenue share, order share, earnings sensitivity or theme importance; missing magnitude remains UNKNOWN.
A theme edge can coexist with multiple formal-industry labels and one issuer can have multiple theme/product edges.
falsification: If a theme universe is reconstructed only from one formal industry code, known cross-industry ABF exposures are omitted.
If all companies in a formal industry are assigned the theme, false positives are created.
Current capability cannot be treated as historical capability before knownAt.
Product capability cannot be converted into revenue/order weight without disclosed basis.
Theme labels from media/analysts remain discovery evidence until issuer/official exposure is independently verified.
promotionReason: A bounded Taiwan prospective many-to-many bridge can now be replayed using official TWSE industry identity plus issuer-official product exposure on the same conservative capture clock. The ABF counterexample proves formal-industry and theme taxonomies are not interchangeable. L3 is bounded PIT feasibility, not complete historical theme membership or exposure magnitude.
exactNext: BR-047 append additional theme bridges across at least two more industries/issuers using the same current prospective clock.
BR-048 seek effective-dated historical theme/exposure vintages before any historical theme-return study.
Do not use theme membership as a score until exposure magnitude/coverage and redundancy versus formal industry are tested.
